description: Two invented card lists, to show the format of a second prompt and to test the lab. Not a tuning set.

cards.title: Gold discount
claims: A gold-tier customer gets 20 percent off the order total.

cards.title: Order
cards.summary: An order has a total and a customer tier.
claims: An order holds a total and the tier of its customer.

cards.title: Checkout page
cards.summary: The page where a customer pays.
claims: The checkout page shows the order total.

cards.title: Late fee
claims: An invoice paid after its due date adds a fee of 2 percent.

cards.title: Mail
claims: Each invoice is sent to the customer by e-mail.
